results.content: Edukans believes that building a future starts with education as the basis and that good education is the key to a country’s sustainable development and hence its most durable investment. Edukans will implement this program in Zomba, Mangochi and Machinga, and is inviting applications from suitable candidates to fill the above position(s):. Reporting to Program Manager, the incumbent will be responsible for the day-to-day micro leadership and management of project implementation in line with the BEFIT design, Edukans policies, and the donor requirements in the designated program impact area. Support the project in equipping the public schools with the required technology and support systems that will facilitate and accelerate learners’ acquisition of reading and numeracy skills. Organize and provide leadership at the district level in the implementation of Befit activities in collaboration with the district, school, and community-level stakeholders. Collaborate with the technical team in building the users’ capacity on the use and care of tablets and related technology to enhance learners’ literacy and numeracy acquisition.

Image 1 ## # Jobs Malawi 1 | VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT @ Luke International (LIN) · 71.1K members. ## Jobs Malawi 1 ·. VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT @ Luke International (LIN). Through the Diabetes Compass project being funded by the World Diabetes Foundation, Luke International has developed a point of care digital system for the management of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) as a microservice in the Malawi HealthCare Information System (MaHIS) for the Malawi Ministry of Health in the first phase of the project. In the second phase of the project, LIN will assist the Ministry of Health to implement the NCD management digital solution in Ntchisi, Karonga and Salima health facilities as a pilot. Therefore, LIN seeks the services of individual IT consultants to assist in carrying out the work in the second phase of the Diabetes Compass project.
